item.title: Cleaning Reddit post in R
item.description: Hey everyone! For a personal summer project, I’m planning to do topic modeling on posts and comments from a movie subreddit. Has anyone successfully used R to clean Reddit data before? Is tidytext powerful enough for cleaning reddit posts and comments? Any tips or experiences would be appreciated!
